officialSources.officialDescriptionSummary: Official HÖ16 sources describe a medium-difficulty section from Lövhult to Ränneborg through varied Småland highland terrain. The description highlights Lövhult's outdoor area and services, Svartåns källa as an early tributary/source of the 165 km Svartån, Hackarevikens naturreservat with deciduous ravine forest and species such as barbastell and gulplister, Fiskaretorpsåsen in Skedhult as an esker/headland in Norra Vixen, and the finish at Ränneborg in Eksjö.
officialSources.appDetailTextDraft: HÖ16 links the service-heavy Lövhult trailhead with Ränneborg on the Eksjö side. The stage is long but well supported by official geometry and has several useful access/facility points: Lövhult for water, camping and bus access, Hackareviken for reserve/rest context, Borgmästarängen for shelters, dry toilet, grill and parking, and Ränneborg for endpoint parking/pickup. Treat Svartåns källa as a scenic official water/source waypoint with reliability caveats rather than guaranteed treated water. Recheck Storm Dave/current notices, fire risk and JLT timetable validity before user-facing publication.

fireRules: MSB API returned no formal fire ban for Eksjö at the Hackareviken query point on 2026-04-29, but this must not be encoded statically.
MSB current risk at Hackareviken was riskIndex 4 / Stor risk for the 2026-04-30 00:00-06:00 forecast period. Use extreme caution and recheck day-of-use.
Hackareviken reserve allows fire only with brought firewood.
Alversjöskogen nearby/off-route rules allow fire only with brought or provided wood.
Use fixed fireplaces where allowed; avoid fire on moss/peat/bare rock and never damage protected-area dead wood.

protectedAreas.visitorRulesSummary: Lövhult rules include parking only in designated areas, no setup of motor vehicles/caravans/motorhomes/trailers, no signs/posters, and no damaging natural objects or standing/fallen dead wood. Hackareviken rules include no damaging natural objects/dead wood, fire only with brought firewood, no motor vehicles except allowed access roads, no overnight caravan/motorhome setup, restrictions on moss/lichen/fungi/plant collection, and permission thresholds for killing insect traps and larger organized events/camps. Water-protection context around Norra/Södra Vixen means avoid contaminating lakes, streams and ditches and keep fuel, chemicals, soaps and waste away from water.
protectedAreas.caveats: Apply protected-area and water-protection rules only to scoped segments. GIS-confirm Norra/Södra Vixen boundary before attaching rule polygons to route segments.

Use leash/control especially in reserves, grazing areas and around horses/cattle.
Lövhult has grazing/highland-cattle context and Hackareviken may have grazing horses.
rulesAndSafety.huntingForestry: No HÖ16-specific hunting or forestry closure notice was found on checked official trail/reserve pages. Forestry/machine work may occur locally and may be adjusted during fire-risk periods; respect local signs and avoid disturbing hunts.
rulesAndSafety.waterSafety: Lövhult water refill is the strongest planned HÖ16 water source. Svartåns källa is official but natural/source-water reliability and current quality are unverified. Avoid polluting Norra/Södra Vixen water-protection area and do not rely on lake/stream water as potable.

conditionReports.summary: Longer Lövhult-Eksjö report notes wet/muddy forest roads from Lövhult, Svartåns källa signed as a side trip, new routing through Hackareviken, steep descent in Hackareviken, noise near road 128, wet pasture sections, shelter side trips and possible shelter issues near the residential Eksjö side.

Longer Lövhult-Eksjö route reviews mention good conditions, a few road-construction reroutes, few rest places and earlier fallen trees easy to walk around. This is longer than official HÖ16 and not post-Storm Dave.
